description: The placeable cameras a View screen renders the world from (the jumbotron recursion) — pure data the binder resolves View screens against at wiring.

items.description: One placeable camera composed from a reference frame, local motion, framing policy, lens, and render target.

name.description: The camera's stable name — the handle a View screen / layout slot samples by.

anchor.description: What the camera rides, or null for the world reference frame.

rig.description: The independent local motion, aim, and lens axes.

smoothRate.description: The presentation-only exponential response rate (per second) the resolved eye eases at; zero disables smoothing. Applies to whichever motion the rig carries.

renderWidth.description: The offscreen render width in pixels.

renderHeight.description: The offscreen render height in pixels.
